name: H. R. Tarbell
role: Manager of the Little Missouri Horse Co. (HT brand)
bio: H. R. (Harry) Tarbell was manager of the Little Missouri Horse Co., which ran the HT brand, and lived with his partner Bond at the Custer Trail ranch from 1884 and later at a ranch on Deep Creek. In March 1885 he argued for using large mares as breeders, and in 1885 and 1886 he advertised and searched for strayed horses, going as far as Standing Rock in March 1886. In December 1885 he measured distances up the Little Missouri from Medora with an odometer, which the paper said would be the authority in future. In October 1886 the paper reported he had decided not to return to the Bad Lands, after the recent death of an uncle.
